name: Low-Poly Generator
description: Generates deterministic low-poly meshes from parameters or natural-language prompts, inspects quad-dominant topology, replays legacy numeric mesh edits, and enforces targetFaceCount as a measured triangle ceiling through topology-guarded reduction. The native WebGL brick is UI-independent and requires no hosted AI provider. Stable-ID editing and runtime baking are owned by presentation.asset_core and presentation.asset_baker.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Library-native POLYFORGE brick with deterministic Node tests for every primitive/prompt family, legacy edits, enforced triangle ceilings, canonical assets, LOD baking, and GLB readback.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.

outputs.name: performanceBudget
outputs.description: Present when targetFaceCount is supplied; reports original, measured, target, collapse count, and withinBudget.

provenance: Adapted from POLYFORGE v0.3 and extended with v0.4 measured budget enforcement; not a voxel mesher, scene editor UI, or hosted AI service.
